CREATE PROCEDURE DW.BUSINESSDATE_LOG_FACT
AS
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE DW.BUSINESSDATE_LOGS;

INSERT INTO DW.BUSINESSDATE_LOGS
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactDepositsOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansCreditLimit' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansCreditLimit  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsCreditLimit' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsCreditLimit  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactSecurityPortfolio' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactSecurityPortfolio  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTrustFundValue' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTrustFundValue  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTotalRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTotalRelationshipBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance  
) A

END




---------UT---------------

SELECT 'Source' as Tables, count(1) cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactDepositsOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactLoansCreditLimit' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactLoansCreditLimit  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsCreditLimit' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsCreditLimit  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsOutstandingBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactCardsRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactSecurityPortfolio' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactSecurityPortfolio  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTrustFundValue' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTrustFundValue  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTotalRelationshipExposure' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure  
UNION ALL  
SELECT 'FactTotalRelationshipBalance' AS TABLES,  MAX(businessdatesk) businessdatesk , GETDATE() InsertDttm  from DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance  
) A) A
UNION all
select 'Target' as Tables, count(1) cnt from DW.BUSINESSDATE_LOGS
